It lists the main menu elements, including available tasks, the AGV serial number, current mode, network connection status, and battery status.", "content_type": ["User Interface Documentation"], "question_intents": ["How to access the AGV HMI application"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_ccf3207344ba0f55500f7719", "title": "AGV - HMI Interface", "summary": "The HMI control for the AMR Formica is accessible via a built-in touch-screen or a remote mobile application, with both methods offering similar functionalities that differ primarily in menu access and manual control methods. The touch-screen interface specifically features main menu tabs, AGV serial number display, and joystick and brake controls within the Manual tab.", "content_type": ["Description"], "question_intents": ["How is the AGV HMI interface accessed and used?"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_931c2b7751b6b4908d664692", "title": "Operation modes", "summary": "This section defines the three AGV operation modes—Automatic, Manual, and Setup—and explains how to switch between them using the main panel switch. It also details the procedure for enabling manual or setup control, including the requirement for a single operator and the specific actions available via the HMI interface.", "content_type": ["Reference"], "question_intents": ["What are the AGV operation modes and how to switch between them?"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_3bccabc8225ad80406bdd26c", "title": "Home", "summary": "The section describes the color-coded safety scanner ranges for AGV speed control and stopping, as well as the display of current speed, position confidence, map location, component status, and energy consumption.", "content_type": ["Technical Documentation"], "question_intents": ["AGV Safety and Status Indicators"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_2fa087f5700d4c78c95c3145", "title": "Fault list", "summary": "The Fault list section provides a convenient overview and management interface for both current and archived faults on an AGV. It outlines the procedure for clearing active faults by verifying the source and using the Clear faults button, which moves them to the Historic faults tab for an 8-hour retention period.", "content_type": ["procedural"], "question_intents": ["How to clear faults"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_c7d540bda819cc94c272e381", "title": "Manual control", "summary": "This section explains how to manually control an AGV using the HMI application. It covers raising and lowering pins and plates, as well as steering the vehicle with a joystick in Manual or Setup modes.", "content_type": ["Instruction"], "question_intents": ["How to steer the AGV with the application?"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_e4ae354cfe7e31ed453640cd", "title": "Network", "summary": "The Network section provides an interface for monitoring the AGV's connectivity to the Qursor network. It displays detailed status information, including WiFi specifics and signal quality.", "content_type": ["UI Description"], "question_intents": ["Check AGV network connection status"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_14f9cac7f33692d8c14e725e", "title": "RFID", "summary": "This section describes the use of RFID technology for goods identification, specifically detailing how an AGV detects and verifies RFID tags to identify risers. It covers the process of reading tag data and registering unique identifiers and riser types within the application.", "content_type": ["Technical Description"], "question_intents": ["How does the AGV identify goods using RFID?"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_6d23e83e10056f2998d3b40c", "title": "Scanners", "summary": "This section details non-contact safety sensors used for collision avoidance in AGVs, specifically describing ultrasonic scanners that assist in environmental localization and distance calculation. It outlines the operational logic of these sensors, which utilize a yellow warning zone to trigger safe speed reduction and a red emergency zone to initiate an immediate stop, thereby protecting personnel and preventing mechanical damage.", "content_type": ["Technical Description"], "question_intents": ["How do non-contact safety sensors function for collision avoidance?"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_3f13efb4911ae2ab45e4499a", "title": "Camera 3D photos", "summary": "This section explains how to view 3D snapshots captured by safety sensors when obstacles are detected in warning or emergency zones. It also details the process for filtering these snapshots by time.", "content_type": ["instruction"], "question_intents": ["How to view and filter 3D snapshots"], "aliases": []}, {"node_id": "n_57bc80f490e8833017ec6033", "title": "Battery data", "summary": "This section provides instructions for accessing detailed battery status information, including metrics such as individual cell voltage, total voltage, current consumption, and state of charge. It also includes guidance on entering full screen mode to view these data points.", "content_type": ["Instructional"], "question_intents": ["How to view battery status"], "aliases": []}]}}
